falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 76% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support, and violation would confirm continuation lower rather than bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled fear/early capitulation; sustained VIX above 35 indicates genuine panic escalation, not the compressed-volatility bottoming signature of August 2024, invalidating the pattern analog

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts and steepens by more than +25bps from current levels within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Rapid curve steepening driven by growth scare or term premium shock would signal macro deterioration inconsistent with a market bottom; August 2024 bottom occurred with curve stable/inverted, so this divergence breaks the pattern validity

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
